cleared_count_after_marked_swap: {match3_rule_text} Following the marked swap arrow, how many gems are cleared?
{match3_rule_text} Count the gems cleared by the marked swap.
{match3_rule_text} What is the immediate clear count for the marked swap?
{match3_rule_text} After the marked swap, how many gems disappear in the immediate clear?
{match3_rule_text} Determine the number of gems cleared by the marked adjacent swap.
created_run_count_after_marked_swap: {match3_rule_text} Following the marked swap arrow, how many matching runs are created?
{match3_rule_text} Count the horizontal or vertical runs created by the marked swap.
{match3_rule_text} What is the immediate created-run count for the marked swap?
{match3_rule_text} After the marked swap, how many matching runs of three or more are present?
{match3_rule_text} Determine the number of matching runs created by the marked adjacent swap.
max_clear_swap_label: {match3_rule_text} Which labeled swap arrow clears the most gems?
{match3_rule_text} Choose the arrow letter whose swap gives the largest immediate clear count.
{match3_rule_text} Among the labeled swap arrows, which one clears the maximum number of gems?
{match3_rule_text} Report the label of the swap arrow with the largest clear count.
{match3_rule_text} Which labeled adjacent swap removes the most gems immediately?
target_clear_swap_label: {match3_rule_text} Which labeled swap arrow clears exactly {target_clear_count} gems?
{match3_rule_text} Choose the arrow letter whose swap has immediate clear count {target_clear_count}.
{match3_rule_text} Among the labeled swap arrows, which one clears {target_clear_count} gems?
{match3_rule_text} Report the label of the swap arrow that clears exactly {target_clear_count} gems.
{match3_rule_text} Which labeled adjacent swap removes exactly {target_clear_count} gems immediately?
